notes.title: What's coming in 1.4?
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for the excellent first week on Steam! This game has done far better than I could have possibly hoped. Unfortunately I can only do so much in one day and I have to spend my time elsewhere for the time being. 

1.4 has got to be the lore update. There is just no way I can put it off anymore. But for a lore update, there needs to be a content addition. What do you want to see added to the game?

Bug reports and suggestions please email FCS@skylorbeck.website please and thank you if I have enough of a plan in place I can find the time to devote to it. 

You can, as always, find me on Patreon above all else. YMBaL coming Q1 2024 if everything goes to plan.

notes.title: V1.3.4 Patch Notes (Cauldron Levels)
notes.content:
With this patch I am attempting to address some concerns players have had. Plinko was overshadowing the entire rest of the game and needed to have it's rewards lowered. Additionally, the Cauldron was too liberal and early players were locking themselves out of it for hours at a time.

[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*]Collectible Count on Marketplace fixed
[/list]
[b]Cauldron:[/b]
[list]
[*] ​Fixed Integer Underflow on currency visualizers
[*] Offline Time Calculation Stability Improvements
[*]​[b]*New* [/b]Cauldron now has a maximum ingredient capacity determined by it's level.
[*] You can increase the level by clicking the cauldron to speed it up, or brewing potions.
[*] Percent Buttons now set the amount to a % of the capacity instead of available mushrooms.
[/list]
[b]​Plinko:
[/b]
[list]
[*] New Collectible Patron and Community names
[*] Score now refreshes properly at the start of the game.
[*] Spore Drop Rate reduced and Potion Drop rate increased.
[*] Spore and Hivemind Point rewards capped at 1
[*] Ball rewards capped at 3.
[*] Minor Prize bar size shrunk by 33%.
[*] Maximum Balls Fired Per Second increased to 6.66... from 5.
[*] Collection Shelf visually condensed to increase information per inch
[*] Portal noise volume lowered
[*] Peg collide noise re-added
[/list]

notes.title: V1.3.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Cauldron Noises play properly again
[*] Upgrade Containers sort to the top left to alleviate navigation needed by the mouse when upgrading a bunch
[*] ​Merchant has new dialogue
[*] New Stats and Bonuses menu where your current stats can be displayed
[*] SaveData changes and improvements
[*] Mushroom Growth Time calculations adjusted slightly
[*] Mushroom Growth now calculated based on a fixed formula instead of "Average last 10s"
[*] Offline Progression added. 10% of online speed. Upgrades in the future?
[*] more SFX fixes
[*] new menu and game music
[/list]

notes.title: v1.3.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] ​Fixed Cauldron Noise playing every time you switch screens
[*] Cauldron expected potions now rounds down properly
[*] Potions can no longer be brewed with 0 mushrooms
[*] Plinko Ball launch rate capped at 5 balls per second to help prevent clogging with macro users
[*] Mushrooms no longer get resized when clicked on
[/list]

notes.title: v1.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] ​New Title Screen
[*] Massive FPS improvements
[*] Settings expanded into a full menu
[*] SFX and Music Toggles turned into sliders
[*] SFX replaced across the entire game
[*] Cauldron can now be tapped to speed up brewing, collect potions and replace fuel
[*] Removed input delay when navigating with keyboard
[*] Camera improvements
[*] Farm Size Caps at 10x10 (Future updates will increase this)
[*] Collectible power reduced to 0.1% per collectible
[/list]
